Five sections carry the signature. Palette (cream/ink/signal red) and type trio (Space Grotesk + Karla + DM Mono) match concept.json. Seven layout families: split-50, ledger-grid, stack-center, rail-horizontal, split-reverse, full-bleed, stack-narrow. No sibling screenshots available for comparison.

type.notes: Space Grotesk display with -0.03em tracking and 0.92 line-height. Karla body at clamp(1rem-1.125rem). DM Mono for data (percent column, sample tags, proof-line, tel-plain). Tabular-nums on ledger rows, estimator bars, phone. Fluid scale with 7 sizes. Scale contrast: h1 at clamp(2.6rem-5rem) vs fs--1 kicker. Lead paragraph set apart with .lead class. No orphans detectable from HTML.

layout.notes: Round 2 fix confirmed: services section now grouped into 3 sub-sections (Structural, Finishes, Specialty) with ledger-group__head labels and ledger-rule dividers between groups (dist/index.html lines 1499-1593). This breaks the monotonous 9-item repetition flagged in round 1. 11 sections with alternating tones. Full-bleed break provides visual breath. Asymmetric split-reverse for permit-check. Dense ledger-list contrasts with quiet stack-center estimator. Score raised from 8.5 to 9 based on confirmed structural fix.
